note: OMIM CDLS7 explicitly lists small hands and fifth finger clinodactyly as clinical skeletal manifestations, though literature cohorts for MAU2 are very small.

evidence.text: The clinical synopsis for Cornelia de Lange syndrome 7 (CDLS7) caused by heterozygous mutation in MAU2 lists skeletal hand features including small hands and fifth finger clinodactyly.

source.quote: SKELETAL Hands - Small Hands. Fifth finger clinodactyly. Cornelia de Lange syndrome-7 (CDLS7) is caused by heterozygous mutation in the MAU2 gene

evidence.text: Peng et al. note that MAU2 loss-of-function variants cause CdLS, but emphasize that as of 2023 extremely few MAU2-CdLS cases had been reported worldwide.

source.quote: Thus far, only one MAU2-CdLS case has been reported worldwide.
